research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Stairwell is researching methods and systems for evaluating uploaded files for malicious and suspicious code and for evaluating files using a rule or feature based system for detection of threats. It is also developing techniques for using files of interest to identify similar files contained in a corpus and for building a real time threat knowledge graph to identify malicious software files. Additional work focuses on detecting security threats on resource constrained appliances. Together, these efforts target automated file centric threat detection and response.

overview_description.description:
Stairwell is a cybersecurity company that offers a platform for Automated Threat Detection and Response that attackers can’t detect or evade. It unlocks time for threat analysis by treating all files as suspicious and pre-preserving them as evidence to speed threat detection and uncover previously unknown compromises. 

The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.  Fast Company has recognized Stairwell as one of the most innovative companies of 2023. We're backed by an incredible lineup of partners, including Accel, Sequoia Capital, Gradient Ventures, and S32 -- not to mention angel investors like Eric Schmidt and Michael Ovitz.

Let's imagine for a moment: What if you could deploy a full compromise assessment equivalent to an advanced incident response firm's typical three-week engagement -- for every file alert from your endpoint or SIEM?

What if, within minutes of a new threat being reported – anything from supply chain attacks like 3CX or SolarWinds, the latest ransomware variant, or Log4j-style vulnerability – you received an authoritative, automated report on your organization's status regarding the threat? Either a completely "clean bill of health" or telling you that your organization WAS impacted, exactly WHERE, and exactly WHEN. Fully automated, powered by AI and machine learning, with absolute "ground truth."

What if you had a neural network at your fingertips, capable of providing accurate threat evaluation, severity assessment, and tracking of not only a specific threat but all of its variants across your enterprise, instantaneously.

What if you could write threat informed detections in YARA and run near instantaneously and continuously over every executable file that's ever been in your organization.

Now, let's stop imagining, because Stairwell makes this a reality. We're amplifying capabilities across the board - from SOC analysts to threat hunters to incident responders - delivering the combined superpowers of a senior incident responder, a top-tier threat hunter, and a senior malware reverse engineer to every team member via an incredible automation solution.

product.name: Stairwell Intelligent Analysis (SIA)
product.description: An AI-driven file analysis platform that evaluates executable files and scripts to determine their safety, behavior, and threat relevance.

product.name: Stairwell Platform
product.description: An enterprise-wide threat detection and investigation platform that continuously collects, stores, and reassesses executable files and indicators of compromise at scale.

product.name: Run to Ground (RTG)
product.description: A threat hunting and alert triage capability that enables instantaneous, enterprise-wide investigations of indicators of compromise and alerts.

product.name: Continuous Threat Analysis
product.description: A service that continuously reanalyzes stored files using updated threat intelligence to detect evolving or delayed threats.

product.name: Cobalt Strike Stager Decoder
product.description: An open-source tool to decode Cobalt Strike stagers, extracting key information such as C2 server details and Malleable C2 profile data.

product.name: Backstory
product.description: An AI-powered malware investigation platform that starts from a security alert and traces related variants, infrastructure, artifacts, systems, and historical activity to determine the full scope of a malware campaign.
